description: Create the Notifications microservice (services/notifications/) and update the CDK stack (infra/lib/autoearsdemo-stack.ts) and README to include it. This is the single end-to-end feature covering the service code, infra, and docs.
findings: tsc --noEmit fails with missing module errors on base state (infra/node_modules not installed in this environment - INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network). Errors are pre-existing and not caused by this feature. All TypeScript syntax in the new CDK additions follows the exact same patterns as the existing code.
steps: Create services/notifications/package.json with name 'notifications-service', same 4 dependencies as services/users/package.json (express, @vendia/serverless-express, @aws-sdk/client-dynamodb, @aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb).
Create services/notifications/handler.js identical in structure to services/users/handler.js - require serverless-express and ./app, export handler.

Create services/notifications/app.js following the exact pattern of services/tasks/app.js: Express app, DynamoDBDocumentClient, TABLE_NAME from process.env.NOTIFICATIONS_TABLE. Implement 5 CRUD routes: GET /notifications (list all, support optional ?userId= filter), GET /notifications/:id, POST /notifications (required fields: userId and message), PUT /notifications/:id (updatable fields: message, read), DELETE /notifications/:id. Notification schema: { id, userId, message, read (boolean, default false), createdAt }.

Update infra/lib/autoearsdemo-stack.ts: add NotificationsTable (DynamoDB, same config as UsersTable/TasksTable, partitionKey id:STRING, PAY_PER_REQUEST, DESTROY), add NotificationsFunction (Lambda NODEJS_18_X, fromAsset('../services/notifications'), env NOTIFICATIONS_TABLE: notificationsTable.tableName), call notificationsTable.grantReadWriteData(notificationsLambda), create HttpLambdaIntegration 'NotificationsIntegration', create HttpApi 'NotificationsApi' (apiName: 'notifications-api'), add 5 routes matching the pattern of usersApi/tasksApi routes, add CfnOutput 'NotificationsApiUrl'.

Update README.md: add Notifications service to the architecture diagram, add a Notifications API Endpoints table (same format as Users/Tasks tables), add NOTIFICATIONS_TABLE to the Environment Variables table, update the deployment instructions to include cd services/notifications && npm install.
acceptance_criteria: services/notifications/app.js exists with GET /notifications, GET /notifications/:id, POST /notifications, PUT /notifications/:id, DELETE /notifications/:id routes
services/notifications/handler.js exists and exports handler via @vendia/serverless-express
services/notifications/package.json exists with the same 4 dependencies as the other services
infra/lib/autoearsdemo-stack.ts contains NotificationsTable, NotificationsFunction, NotificationsApi, and NotificationsApiUrl output
Running tsc --noEmit in infra/ exits with code 0 (no TypeScript errors)
